item.title: Testing the Hypothesis That Culture Is Parasitic on Unsatisfied Human Needs
item.description: Finds good evidence that some cultural use compensates for frustrated needs and that some digital affects are self-reinforcing, but reserves the stronger label “parasitic” for systems shown to benefit from recurrent unresolved need rather than inferring dependence from market size or cultural popularity.
